# Data Quality Notes
*Generated by `felix_04_quality_numbers.R` on 2026-10-28. Numbers sourced from `outputs/tables/quality_numbers.csv`.*

---

## NVD

**Overall, 3.6 % of CVEs in the dataset lack a CVSS v3 score (11,450 of 315,909).** The gap is concentrated in the most recent years: 5.5 % of 2025 CVEs and 9.6 % of 2026 CVEs are unscored at v3 level, compared to 0 % for 2017–2021. The 2016 cohort has a small residual gap of 3.7 % (205 entries) from before v3 was standardised.

**The share of CVSS scores supplied by the original reporter rather than NVD has grown sharply since 2022.** In 2016–2021 NVD scored more than 90 % of entries directly. By 2024 only 58.4 % were NVD-scored; by 2025 that fell to 36.7 %; and in the 2026 cohort NVD supplied just 17.9 % of scores, with 82.1 % coming from reporters. Reporter-supplied scores have not been independently validated by NVD and should be treated with additional caution in any model that uses CVSS as a feature.

---

## KEV

**205 KEV entries (11.7 % of 1,756) have no CVSS v3 counterpart in the NVD dataset.** All 205 belong to CVEs published before 2016, when CVSS v3 did not exist: the largest clusters are CVE-2015 (48 entries), CVE-2013 (38), CVE-2014 (34), CVE-2012 (22), and CVE-2010 (23). One anomalous entry carries a CVE-2026 ID and is likely a data-entry error in the source file. These 205 entries are excluded from any analysis that requires a CVSS v3 score; they remain available for separate frequency analysis.

---

## CA Quarterly Reports

**24 of 25 canonical PDF files are usable.** `CA_cyber_2024-10.pdf` fails `pdf_info()` (truncated download, exactly 1 048 576 bytes, no trailer dictionary); a replacement copy (`CA_cyber_2024-10_new.pdf`) has been downloaded and verified but not yet renamed. All remaining 24 quarters produce readable output.

**4 quarters have been encoded in `ca_entry_FK.csv` so far; all four category sums equal the reported total exactly.** The remaining quarters (FY 2021/22 Q1 through FY 2026/26 Q3) are pending double-entry by Felix. No sum discrepancy has been found in the encoded subset.
